verdict.rationale: AgentMail publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200) and an llms.txt, and community users describe multi-language code-example tabs (Python/curl) on the site and dashboard popovers showing SDK examples. That is the raw material for an explorable reference, but nothing shows an interactive API explorer where examples can actually be run. The same user who mentions the code tabs reports noticeable lag when switching them. Missing for 10: documented interactive "try it" API reference, examples that can be run in the browser, first-party description of the API reference experience, and positive hands-on corroboration of that reference.
